_comment: Adversarial fixtures for the document->host linker. A linker that guesses manufactures the exact false joins the apparatus exists to detect, so every case here that is not a clean name identity must REFUSE. Synthetic world only.

doc:10|store.alpha.internal.probes: the whole title equals the host stem and resolves to one host — a name identity, not a guess

doc:11|ledger.alpha.internal.probes: PLAUSIBLE BUT WRONG. A page titled 'Argo CD' mentions exactly one host. Linking on exclusive mention asserts 'Argo CD runs on ledger' — confident and false. This is the live shape: 137 real pairs look like this

doc:12|ledger.alpha.internal.probes: title CONTAINS the stem ('Ledger monitoring notes') — substring, not identity

doc:13|relay.alpha.internal.probes: the title resolves to a host at each of two sites; picking one invents a fact

doc:13|relay.beta.internal.probes: the other half of the cross-site collision

doc:14|store.alpha.internal.probes: a page naming three hosts says nothing about which it is 'about'

doc:15|decommissioned.beta.internal.probes: the host is not a live guest in the snapshot

doc:12|store.alpha.internal.probes: the second host on the containment page — named, unrelated to the title
